name: Vehicle General Safety Regulation
evidence_rating: ex-ante only: applies to all new vehicles since July 2024; first Commission evaluation due July 2027
summary: The mandatory safety systems apply to new vehicle types since July 2022 and to all new vehicles since July 2024; the Commission must report on their effect, including real-world performance of intelligent speed assistance, by 7 July 2027. No evaluation exists yet.

literature.citation: European Commission (2018), Impact Assessment accompanying the proposal on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles as regards their general safety, SWD(2018) 190 (executive summary SWD(2018) 191)
literature.title: Impact Assessment accompanying the proposal on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles as regards their general safety
literature.headline: Mandatory advanced safety systems expected to reduce road deaths and serious injuries; costs passed on in vehicle prices
literature.summary_plain: The Commission expected the new mandatory safety systems to save lives on EU roads.
